metadata.description: Mr. Victor Malto is a leading voice in Jharkhand advocating for the effective implementation of the Provisions of the Panchayats (Extension to Scheduled Areas) Act, 1996 (PESA). He actively highlights the importance of empowering tribal communities through self-governance and protecting their rights over land, water, and forests. The ongoing debate around the formation of PESA rules in Jharkhand has made his contributions significant in shaping the discourse on tribal autonomy and governance in the state.
